turns.belt: How do I calculate the cost of the gap?
turns.answer:
To calculate the cost of the gap, you multiply the annual volume of complaints by the current late-closure rate (as a decimal) and then multiply that by the cost per late complaint. This gives you the yearly cost of poor quality due to late closures.
